name.value: Canadas Best Value Inn & Suites Kamloops

description.value: Canadas Best Value Inn & Suites Kamloops is a mid-range motel on Columbia Street offering easy access to the Trans-Canada Highway and Kamloops' downtown core and riverfront. The property is part of the Sonesta brand family and features an on-site café, Kirsten's Hideout, where guests receive a complimentary American-style breakfast each morning. Standard rooms include a mini-fridge and microwave, while suites offer full kitchenettes and separate living space for longer stays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms a real, open motel at 1390 Columbia St, Kamloops, matching OSM address and phone number. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated ('free Wi-Fi in your room and throughout the hotel') and laundry amenities are mentioned ('laundry or business amenities'). concerns: OSM email domain is 'acadianinnkamloops.net', suggesting the property may have previously operated as 'Acadian Inn Kamloops'; the current website makes no reference to this name and is branded under Sonesta/Red Lion. Email may be outdated or incorrect.
Address in OSM lacks postal code; website provides full address as '1390 Columbia St, Kamloops, BC V2C 2W8' which has been used here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with confirmed amenities and a matching address, phone, and website. Useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Kamloops.
enrichment_extras.notes: Complimentary breakfast is offered each morning at the on-site Kirsten's Hideout Café. Free on-site parking with ample space for larger vehicles is also noted on the website, which may be useful for cyclists with support vehicles.
